tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Current and previous-session spot prices for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper and nickel, in any supported currency and per troy ounce or gram.

tools.name: get_observed_premiums
tools.description: Rolling fine-metal-weighted median asking premiums for silver, gold, platinum, palladium, copper, nickel and Goldback, observed from marketplace listings.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily historical series for charting — one metal or the Goldback.

tools.name: get_goldback_rate
tools.description: The latest Goldback premium multiple over its gold content, and the exchange rate that follows from it.

tools.name: list_supported_currencies
tools.description: The live list of codes every `currency`/`base` parameter accepts — ISO 4217 fiat plus the metal codes.

tools.name: get_how_to_use
tools.description: StackerScan's How to Use guide in any app language: its table of contents, or one section as markdown quoting the app's own button and field labels. Sections: createAccount (Your Account), stackSettings (Stack Settings), addItems (Adding Items to Your Stack), editItems (Editing, Selling and Deleting

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_how_to_use" is 650 chars, far longer than this server's median (128). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
